description: I believe everyone has a right to accessible affordable housing. I believe that we must attend to the housing crisis that is affecting the state of Rhode Island and the city of Pawtucket so urgently. I support policies that keep housing accessible and affordable for regular people, especially as we anticipate high levels of development […]
